name: Shalash (Ash)
title: Herald of Beauty
summary: The patron of the Lightweavers. Daughter of Jezrien, Shalash wandered Roshar destroying artwork and sculptures that depicted her, driven by an intense self-loathing. She believed the Heralds were unworthy of the reverence humanity gave them.
honorbladeGrants: Illumination and Transformation — the power to create illusions and to transform one substance into another.
quote: "Erase me from your memory. Burn my image. I am not worthy of worship."
